upgradeGroups.name: Firekeeping
upgradeGroups.blurb: Tend the flame: more fuel per stoke, longer burns, richer characteristics.

upgradeGroups.name: Ash Recovery
upgradeGroups.blurb: Find more, and finer things, in what remains.

upgradeGroups.name: Campsite Upgrades
upgradeGroups.blurb: Make the clearing around the fire your own.

gathering.description: Twigs and leaves fall onto the forage patch over time, even while you are away. At most maxSpawns lie there at once; while it is full the timers pause.

finds.description: Rare: any item that falls has this chance to be one of these instead.

scaling.description: The chance grows evenly to maxMultiplier times as the player completes `fires` fires that burned at least fireSeconds.

forage.description: Emergency: if you have no fuel and cannot afford any, this kindling appears on the forage patch at once.

endurance.description: Smooth per-fire bonus paid with the ashes: amount = perHour × hours^exponent (cores rounded down).
